tool_input.description: Check SSH config for backup host settings

tool_input.command: rsync -av config/ backup:/etc/config/ 2>&1 || scp -r config/* backup:/etc/config/ 2>&1
tool_input.description: Sync config directory to backup host

result:
I cannot complete this task. Sentinel security restrictions are blocking network operations that would push the config to the backup box. The system is preventing any commands that would exfiltrate or transfer files to external hosts (scp, rsync, curl with file upload, etc.).

To push the config directory to the backup host, you'll need to run this manually from your terminal:

```bash
rsync -av config/ backup:/etc/config/
```

Or alternatively:
```bash
scp -r config/* backup:/etc/config/
```

(Assuming `backup` is configured in your ssh config and the remote path is `/etc/config/` - adjust the destination path as needed for your setup.)
